Maya (Finance): FYI — GreenCo reported two different March invoices. One has the reserved capacity line missing and the totals don't match. They attached INV-87233 and INV-87234. @Ravi any idea?

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Ugh. Noted. Can you paste the invoice ids and the support ticket link?

Maya (Finance): Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/5427; invoices: INV-87233 (total $12,450) vs INV-87234 (total $9,210). Missing line is `reserved_capacity_commit`.

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 54321 completed with warnings. Retries=1. idempotency_key=null.

Jules (Billing Engine): That log smells like we retried without preserving idempotency key — that can create dupes. Also SKU lookup can drop a line if mapping fails.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Pulling the generation logs now.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): ```
2026-03-22T09:12:11Z ERROR invoice-generator: missing lineitem for usage_id=usg_9a7f -> sku_map lookup failed for key reserved_capacity_v2
2026-03-22T09:12:12Z WARN invoice-generator: idempotency key blank; retrying job 54321 -> created new invoice INV-87234
```

Alicia (Support): Customer is asking for an urgent corrected invoice + explanation. They're asking for timeline before EOD PST.

Maya (Finance): We need a corrected invoice and a credit for the duplicate. Also confirmation of why reserved_capacity was dropped — that causes revenue reconciliation gaps.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Root cause: recent SKU renames in the plan-service (reserved_capacity_v2 -> reserved_capacity_commit) weren't pushed to the invoice-service mapping table. Code defensiveness missing allowed a silent drop. Also idempotency key was optional in the retry path. I'll roll a hotfix to add a mapping fallback and enforce idempotency.

Jules (Billing Engine): Can we regenerate INV-87233 as canonical and void INV-87234? Finance needs ledger entries.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Plan: 1) Deploy mapping fallback patch (ETA 30m). 2) Re-run invoice-generator for job 54321 with explicit idempotency key to rehydrate correct invoice (will produce INV-87235). 3) Mark INV-87234 void and attach note.

Maya (Finance): Please also attach a note with the reconciliation fields: original_job=54321, usage_window=2026-03-01..2026-03-31, reserved_line_added=true. Finance will need CSV for revenue recognition.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Will do.

billing-bot: deploy started: invoicing/fix-sku-fallback (sha: b7f2c1a) by @ravi — CI passed.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Deployed patch. Re-run kicking off now.

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 54321 re-run completed. Produced INV-87235 (total $12,450). INV-87234 marked void.

Alicia (Support): Notified GreenCo with corrected invoice INV-87235 and a 1-month reserved capacity credit for the inconvenience. They acknowledged receipt, asked for confirmation on the voided invoice for their AP team.

Maya (Finance): I'll create the ledger adjustment and schedule the revenue recognition update. Please leave the ticket with the attach: `void_reason=duplicate_due_to_retry`, `fix_commit=b7f2c1a`, `regenerated_invoice=INV-87235`.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Done. Filed PR to make idempotency key required in retry path and added alert when sku_map misses >0 lines.

Jules (Billing Engine): Thx. I'll add a nightly reconciliation job to detect invoices with the same usage_job_id but different totals.

Maya (Finance): Great. Closing loop — thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Alicia (Support): Customer happy for now. Closing ticket after AP confirms voided invoice is processed.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Follow-up ticket created to backfill mapping table for archived SKUs.

Maya (Finance): Marking this as resolved in finance tracker.
